name: utopia/mock-server-mqtt
description: Dependencies for app/mqtt.php (the mock MQTT broker), installed to ./vendor-mqtt. Kept separate from the HTTP mock's composer.json because utopia-php/mqtt needs utopia-php/telemetry ^0.4, which the mock's utopia-php/framework (older telemetry line, carries param(model:)) does not allow. Committed with a lock so CI installs a reproducible tree.
